Package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.grove

@NullMarked package io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.grove
Zero-allocation drivers and pin names for peripherals connected through the Grove Base Shield.

The shield is passive: its analog, digital, I2C and UART sockets are the UNO header pins exposed by GroveBaseShield. A driver such as GroveDht22 is therefore ordinary Java built from the low-level GPIO and timing intrinsics.
